turn.content: The contract sets fixed unit prices (Annex A, clause 2.1) with changes only via addendum. The only addendum is for a completely different item (Kursi Kantor Ergonomis), so it does not cover either invoice line. Let me verify there's no addendum covering these two items by checking the vendor's ledger invoices too.
